messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up: ran a focused onboard eval for nova8b-int6 vs our 12B baseline on short-chat and multi-turn summarization.

rahul: short summary pls

zoe: numbers first:
```
baseline-12b-fp16: cost/req $0.0108, p50 95ms, p95 380ms, sum-F1 0.762
candidate-nova8b-int6: cost/req $0.0065, p50 100ms, p95 420ms, sum-F1 0.744
```
Net: ~40% cost savings, small summary F1 drop (~1.8 pts). p95 tail about +40ms (mostly on cold KV misses).

mei: any safety or hallucination regressions?

zoe: none obvious in the studied slices, but one language-specific style slice showed mild brevity bias (shorter answers).

rahul: product asks for recommendation: safe to pilot? what's the microbudget threshold?

zoe: propose pilot routing if blended cost/request < $0.0075 and p95 < 450ms. With 10% safety routing to baseline via a small classifier (recall 0.95) blended cost becomes $0.0069.

mei: rollout plan?

zoe: Canary 1% non-sensitive traffic, ramp to 25% over 7 days, monitor sum-F1, brevity metrics, p95, and classifier FN. Rollback if sum-F1 drops >2.5 pts or p95 > 460ms for 30m.

deploybot: canary image built (infer-nova8b-int6:2026-11-12-rc1). Canary config at /deploy/canary/3842109999-nova8b.json

rahul: good. add CI microtest: summary F1 delta <3.0 pts on nightly sample.

zoe: will upload S3 slice + README after canary config PR. Starting canary tomorrow 09:00 PT unless objections. :rocket:
